flowchart TD
  subgraph Compte["Compte AWS"]
    ACC["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/account/main.tf"]
    VPC["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/vpc/main.tf"]
    TGW["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/transit-gateway/transit-gateway.tf"]
    FW["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/inspection/firewall.tf"]
  end
  subgraph EKS["Cluster EKS"]
    CLU["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/vpc/eks/cluster.tf"]
    CORE["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/vpc/eks/core/main.tf"]
    COMP["terraform/aws-accounts/cloud-platform-aws/vpc/eks/core/components/main.tf"]
  end
  subgraph Tests["Tests Go"]
    HELP["test/helpers/client.go"]
    ING["test/ingress_controller_test.go"]
  end
  GLOB["terraform/global-resources/main.tf"]
  ACC --> VPC
  VPC --> CLU
  CLU --> CORE --> COMP
  VPC --> TGW
  TGW --> FW
  GLOB --> ACC
  HELP --> ING
  ING --> COMP
explication: Terraform est découpé en états séparés : ressources globales, compte, VPC, cluster EKS, composants de base puis composants optionnels. Les tests Go de test/ vérifient ensuite les composants déployés comme l'ingress controller.
